title: Old Enemies, New Vengeance
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan's words exploded like thunder beside his ears. What did the phenomenon of skeletal remains three months later truly signify? Chen Ji's hand gripping the Tianji Record Fragment trembled slightly. The door to truth was slowly creaking open.

text.content:
The chaotic vortex swallowed Chen Ji whole. The power of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key pierced through his Mental Sea like countless fine needles. The excruciating pain spread from his chest to every limb, and the clear premonition images before his eyes shattered into fragments dancing through the air.

He saw his father's silhouette. Within that blurred light and shadow, Chen Xuan seemed to be saying something, but his voice was torn to shreds by the vortex, nothing audible.

"Cough——" Chen Ji knelt on one knee, a mouthful of blood spraying onto the blue stone ground. In that pool of blood, the light of the Tianji Record Fragment flickered uncertainly.

He shouldn't have forcibly invoked the Tianji Record at this moment, but Chen Nian's whereabouts were right before his eyes... He silently chanted this name in his heart, and the tearing agony in his chest seemed to ease slightly.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji covers his chest, raising his head with difficulty) Who goes there? Hiding and skulking, afraid to show yourself?

text.content:
The moment his voice fell, a low rumbling sound suddenly echoed from the depths of the forbidden grounds at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Chen Ji's pupils constricted——the sect's forbidden grounds sealing formation was being deliberately triggered.

Thick fog surged from the valley, yet eerily bypassed Chen Ji's vicinity within three feet. Within the fog, a hunched yet commanding figure slowly materialized.

It was the Old Sect Master Ling Yuan.

He still wore that faded gray robe, snow-white hair cascading over his shoulders, his face aged yet bearing a depth that made others dare not meet his gaze. But now, his figure seemed even more ethereal than days before, as if he might dissipate in the wind at any moment.

dialogue.content:
(Ling Yuan's voice carries an indescribable exhaustion) You foolish child... Knowing the Heavenly Fate Lock Key would interfere with the Tianji Record, why did you still forcibly peer into the heavens?

(He walks closer slowly, his gaze falling on the faintly glowing fragment on Chen Ji's chest) Chen Xuan was equally stubborn back then. Knowing it was a dead end, he insisted on defying heaven.

(Chen Ji forces himself to stand, blood still staining the corner of his mouth, yet his eyes burn with chilling intensity) The Old Sect Master is indeed in high spirits, your first act after awakening is to seek me out in the forbidden grounds?

(He casually steps back half a pace, shielding the Tianji Record Fragment behind him) You are not worthy of speaking my father's name.

text.content:
Upon hearing this, a bitter smile actually appeared on Ling Yuan's aged face. He didn't press forward but stopped three zhang away, allowing his ethereal form to waver in the mist.

"Not worthy of speaking his name?" Ling Yuan softly repeated these three words, his smile carrying inexplicable meaning. "Perhaps. But Chen Ji, do you know that when the Tianji Record selected its wielder, it wavered between you and your father for three entire years?"

These words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer. Mo Xiansheng had told him that the Tianji Record's selection was heaven-ordained, with no exceptions. Yet this old man before him claimed...

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji's gaze sharpens, yet his voice grows increasingly calm) Three years?

(His mind races rapidly—if Ling Yuan speaks truth, then what Mo Xiansheng has concealed is likely far more extensive) What are you trying to say?

(Ling Yuan's gaze passes over Chen Ji, as if gazing at some distant past) I'm saying... your father Chen Xuan was the only opponent I ever truly acknowledged, and also my best friend once.

(His voice suddenly drops) Thirty years ago during that upheaval, I watched him walk into the trap of the Heavenly Eye, yet could do nothing. You think I inherited the Tianqing Sect for what reason?

text.content:
Chen Ji froze.

In his understanding, Ling Yuan was a hypocritical villain secretly coveting the Tianji Record, the man who murdered his father. Mo Xiansheng had warned him repeatedly—this man's depths are unfathomable, not to be trusted lightly.

Yet the sorrow and guilt in this old man's eyes didn't seem like an act.

Ling Yuan seemed to read his thoughts, giving a tragic smile: "Of course you won't believe me. If our positions were reversed, I wouldn't believe it either."

dialogue.content:
(Ling Yuan raises his hand, his aged fingertip pointing distantly at the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's hand) Do you know why the Tianji Record selected you instead of your father?

(His voice turns ethereal) Because it knew long ago... that Chen Xuan would die. It selected you to have you... accomplish what it itself could not.

text.content:
These words struck like a basin of ice water over his head.

The fingers Chen Ji used to grip the Tianji Record Fragment turned slightly pale. He had always believed himself to be the chess player, the one weaving schemes amid chaos. But now, Ling Yuan was telling him he might have been a piece on the Tianji Record's board from the very beginning?

"You're lying!" Chen Ji roared, his voice carrying for the first time an undeniable tremor.

dialogue.content:
(Ling Yuan shakes his head, a flicker of pity passing through his aged eyes) If I could lie, back then I wouldn't have had to watch your father walk into his doom helplessly.

(He suddenly lowers his voice, his tone urgent) Chen Ji, I have no time left. The Heavenly Eye has noticed your growth. Three months from now... there will be a phenomenon of skeletal remains.届时 it will personally intervene. Before then, you must find your sister.

(Chen Ji's pupils dilate dramatically, alarm bells ringing in his heart) How do you know about Chen Nian?

(He instinctively steps back, the talisman hidden in his sleeve already quietly activated) Old geezer, your acting is better than I expected. Unfortunately——

(He coldly smiles) Haven't you always wanted to kill me and seize the Tianji Record? Why bother putting on this kind facade?

text.content:
Upon hearing this, Ling Yuan didn't flare with anger. Instead, he laughed. That laughter was bleak and mournful, echoing through the mist, lingering endlessly.

"Kill you?" Ling Yuan's laughter abruptly stopped, a sneer appearing on his aged face. "If I wanted you dead, why would I wait until today?"

He waved his hand, a flash of light appeared, and the scene before Chen Ji suddenly changed—he saw a memory that didn't belong to him.

That was the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain thirty years ago.

Young Ling Yuan and Chen Xuan stood side by side, their faces still bearing the pride of youth. In the scene, Chen Xuan handed an infant in his arms to Ling Yuan, his eyes filled with earnest pleading.

"If I don't return from this journey, help me take care of Ji'er."

The scene shifted. Same back mountain, Chen Xuan's back figure gradually disappearing into the distance. Ling Yuan's outstretched hand hung in midair, yet ultimately couldn't retain that person.

Then came raging flames, and a woman being taken away by the Holy Sect—that was Chen Nian's mother.

choice.prompt: Was the memory Ling Yuan displayed real or fabricated? Chen Ji needed to judge while in shock—this concerned his future plans, and also whether he could bear the weight of yet another truth.

choices.description: This memory is too vivid. If Ling Yuan truly was an old friend of his father, his hostility all these years might have hidden motives. Might as well hear what else he has to say.
choices.visible_cost: Expose More Information to Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Potentially obtain crucial intelligence about his father and the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan's words are false, Chen Ji will fall completely into a passive position

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, quietly putting away the talisman in his sleeve. He stared into Ling Yuan's eyes, speaking word by word: "Fine, I'll listen to what you have to say. But if you dare deceive me——"

He didn't finish, but the coldness in those eyes was more terrifying than any threat. Ling Yuan, gazing at his manner, momentarily saw the shadow of that man from thirty years ago.

choices.description: Memories can be forged, and what one sees isn't necessarily truth. Chen Ji decided to first probe Ling Yuan's bottom cards, to see how much he truly knows and how much he's hiding.
choices.visible_reward: Force Ling Yuan to expose more information
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan's scheming runs deeper, Chen Ji's probing might instead fall into his rhythm

text.content:
A derisive arc curved at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth as he leisurely straightened his robes. "The Old Sect Master's acting is indeed superb. Only this junior is obtuse, and wishes to ask——"

He paused, cold light suddenly flashing in his eyes: "Since you were an old friend of my father's, what have you been doing these thirty years?"

choices.text: Secretly Set Up Barriers for Vigilance
choices.description: Regardless of what Ling Yuan says, Chen Ji won't easily trust him. He secretly laid out backup plans, in case this old fox turns hostile at any moment.
choices.visible_cost: If Ling Yuan notices, Chen Ji's sincerity will vanish entirely
choices.visible_reward: Prepare for the Worst Case Scenario
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is a cunning schemer. His current state of residual soul might hide unknown trump cards

text.content:
Chen Ji lowered his eyes, putting on a thoughtful expression. In truth, his divine consciousness quietly spread out, carving three hidden barrier rune patterns into the blue stone beneath his feet.

These barriers showed no异样 ordinarily, but with merely a thought from him, they could sever all vitality within a three-zhang radius.

After completing this, Chen Ji raised his head: "Please, Old Sect Master, continue."

dialogue.content:
(Ling Yuan observes Chen Ji's reaction, a flicker of approval passing through his turbid eyes) You're more cautious than Xuan'er. That's good.

(He sighs) These thirty years, I've been waiting for an opportunity. Waiting for the Heavenly Eye to relax its guard, waiting for you to grow strong enough to shake it. Now... the time is almost here.

text.content:
Ling Yuan's form grew increasingly ethereal, as if it might dissolve in the wind at any moment. Yet he seemed unconcerned, merely gazing at the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's hand, his expression carrying ineffable complexity.

"The Heavenly Eye is not invincible." Ling Yuan's voice gradually grew distant. "It has weaknesses."

He extended a finger, pointing distantly at Chen Ji's brow center. An information torrent surged into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a tide—those were fragments of the Heavenly Eye's operational mechanism.

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply.

The content within that information torrent was far more shocking than he had imagined—the essence of the Heavenly Eye was an ancient fierce beast parasitizing within the Heavenly Dao's will. It fed on the fortune of the world, used seers as chess pieces, and for thousands of years had been manipulating the entire cultivation world's trajectory.

And the Tianji Record was precisely its tool for harvesting seers.

"Your father discovered this truth." Ling Yuan's voice seemed to come from very far away. "Therefore, he chose to actively walk into his doom, exchanging his life for the Tianji Record's evolutionary opportunity."

choice.prompt: The cause of his father's death was gradually becoming clear, but this truth was too heavy. Chen Ji needed to sort through his thoughts amid the shock, deciding how to respond to this truth that might overturn his understanding.

choices.text: Ask About His Father's Final Whereabouts
choices.description: Since Ling Yuan knows so much, then how exactly did his father die back then? What about Chen Nian's mother being taken by the Holy Sect? These questions must be answered.
choices.visible_cost: Expose Chen Ji's Care for His Family
choices.visible_reward: Might obtain clues for finding Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's information might be incomplete, or even deliberately misleading

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji's voice trembles slightly, yet he努力 suppresseses his emotions) My father... did he leave any last words before dying?

(He stares intently at Ling Yuan's ethereal form) And Chen Nian's mother, what about her after being taken by the Holy Sect?

choices.description: This information is too crucial. Ling Yuan has no reason to share it freely. Chen Ji needs to figure out what this old fox is really after from him.
choices.visible_reward: Force Ling Yuan to Reveal His Cards
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan is hiding something, Chen Ji's questioning might play right into his hands

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji snorts coldly, arms crossed) What grand words. The Heavenly Eye's weaknesses? Old Sect Master, why not speak clearly.

(He narrows his eyes, his tone chilling) You've expended your residual soul's power, specially coming to deliver this grand gift to me... I want to know what you're really after.

(Ling Yuan's form suddenly trembles violently, as if it might disperse at any moment) What I'm after... is my life.

(He gives a tragic smile) Back then I was selected by the Tianji Record, yet abandoned by it. This obsession has tormented me for thirty years. Now my time is nearly up. Rather than letting this residual soul be devoured by the Heavenly Eye, I might as well... give it to you.

text.content:
Before his words even finished, Ling Yuan's form suddenly exploded into countless motes of light. Those motes didn't scatter but surged like a flood, frantically pouring into the Tianji Record Fragment within Chen Ji's body.

"No——" Chen Ji tried to stop them, yet found his body completely immobile.

After absorbing Ling Yuan's residual soul, the fragment suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light. The originally incomplete third page actually slowly manifested text——that was the crucial page of the Tianji Record that Ling Yuan had supplemented with his lifetime of cultivation.

dialogue.content:
(Ling Yuan's voice echoes within the golden light, carrying boundless vicissitudes and release) Chen Ji... Remember, the phenomenon of skeletal remains three months from now... that is your only chance...

(His voice grows increasingly distant) Find your sister... She is... the Heavenly Fate Lock Key... and also your only...

His words cut off abruptly. Ling Yuan's form completely dissipated, leaving only dust dancing in the air, refracting a bleak yet heroic gleam in the morning light.

text.content:
Chen Ji stood in place, long无言.

He lowered his head to look at the freshly renewed Tianji Record Fragment in his hand. The text on it jumped like living creatures. The information Ling Yuan left before his death was too vast, requiring time for him to slowly digest.

But one thing he had already determined——the phenomenon of skeletal remains three months from now. Ling Yuan said that was his only chance.

Chen Nian... He gripped the fragment tightly, his knuckles white. Regardless of whether Ling Yuan's words were true or false, he had to find Chen Nian. She was his only remaining blood relative in this world, and also the key piece for his scheme to overturn destiny and manipulate the world.

He raised his head, his gaze穿透重重迷雾, looking toward the direction of the distant Holy Sect.
